understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete the level by activating all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time, and you step onto the goal tile. Completing all goals advances you; losing all lives ends the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a move (north/south/east/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, in which case your position does not change but you still spend stamina. Moving normally costs stamina; when stamina reaches zero, the next action that would spend stamina causes you to lose a life and your stamina resets. The carried piece’s attributes are modified by stepping on modifier tiles: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. To finish a goal, you must use modifiers to reach the exact required shape/color/rotation and then step onto the goal cell while matched.
